purpose: Triggers an action with semantic emphasis, including destructive, icon-only, disabled, and loading actions.
useWhen: Showing an action that can become disabled or busy.
Presenting a compact icon-only action with an accessible name.

avoidWhen.situation: The control navigates to another location.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use a semantic navigation link instead of an action button.

supportedInteractions: Busy loading state through isLoading or isPending
approvedPatterns: Use danger intent for destructive actions.
Pair leading or trailing icons with visible action text.
Keep visible content mounted while loading to preserve dimensions.
Use isLoading or isPending interchangeably; both mark the button busy.
Set highContrast explicitly on each secondary Button used on a prominent surface, such as an informational Toast.
limitations: Accent treatment is supported only with the fill appearance.
Icon sizing is supplied by the consumer.
highContrast defaults to false and applies only to secondary fill, transparent, and ghost appearances; other intents ignore it.
The consumer supplies the background surface. highContrast does not detect the surface automatically or inherit from Toast or Alert.
accessibility: Provide aria-label or aria-labelledby for icon-only buttons.
Provide an accessible name when loading without visible children.
Loading uses isPending and aria-busy while keeping the button focusable; it is not native disabled.
responsive: Choose a size appropriate to the available space and interaction context.
rtl: Order directional leading and trailing content for the active writing direction.
